description: The store banner: run while bookmarks.json is read-only, a newer schema's file, a 1.0 file whose upgrade failed, a missing file none of whose snapshots can be restored, or since Bookmarks 1.2 an unreadable file nothing can replace (scripts/README.md says how). As admin, the Capabilities say StoreReadOnly with its reason, GET /Bookmarks/Admin/Diagnostics has the read-only Store, and Bookmarks' settings page shows the store's sentence as a warning banner (an amber bar and tint) at its top, above the settings and in view without scrolling, as text; its Diagnostics section lists the copies kept next to the file.

steps.name: the Store entry: read-only, with its sentence
the page has the store banner, and Diagnostics loaded
the banner is the store's sentence, as plain text, an alert
the banner's look and place
steps.eval: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide) .bookmarksStoreBanner'); const cs = getComputedStyle(b); const r = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return { borderLeftStyle: cs.borderLeftStyle, borderLeftWidth: cs.borderLeftWidth, borderLeftColor: cs.borderLeftColor, background: cs.backgroundColor, color: cs.color, top: Math.round(r.top), bottom: Math.round(r.bottom), height: Math.round(r.height), viewport: innerHeight }; })()

steps.name: styled as a warning: an amber bar and tint
above the settings form and the Diagnostics section, in view without scrolling
steps.assert: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigPage:not(.hide)'); const b = p.querySelector('.bookmarksStoreBanner'); const F = Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING; return !!(b.compareDocumentPosition(p.querySelector('#BookmarksConfigForm')) & F) && !!(b.compareDocumentPosition(p.querySelector('#BookmarksDiagnostics')) & F) && __vars.look.top >= 0 && __vars.look.bottom <= __vars.look.viewport && __vars.look.height > 0; })()

steps.name: the sentence isn't repeated in Diagnostics, which has the file's line
the kept copies are listed when there are any
steps.assert: __vars.diagnostics.Store.KeptFiles.every(f => __vars.summary.includes(f.Name)) && (__vars.diagnostics.Store.KeptFiles.length === 0) === !__vars.summary.includes('Kept next to it until you delete them:')

steps.name: open the Diagnostics tab and scroll to it
no uncaught exceptions (the stale CustomRatings tag, and jellyfin-web's Home tab pausing its slider as the page is left, excepted)
